name: BraTS
description: Brain Tumor Segmentation (BraTS) challenge dataset of multimodal brain MRI scans with expert tumor-region annotations for glioma segmentation.
citation: Menze et al., The Multimodal Brain Tumor Image Segmentation Benchmark (BRATS), IEEE TMI, 2015.

license.notes: Access and usage are subject to the challenge data terms; human MRI data are not vendored.
